reuse.why: Extracts getUpcomingDates' weekend logic into applyWeekendHandling and uses it from both handlers, reusing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule pipeline; the same daily-skip rule in shared getNextDate and schedule-template is left as separate copies.

duplication.why: The new handler shares the weekend step with getUpcomingDates instead of copying it; getUpcomingDates still recomputes skipsWeekendDays for its take count, and the rule remains duplicated with shared/schedules.ts.

placement.why: The handler sits correctly next to getUpcomingDates, but the weekend helper is a private function in server/schedules/app.ts when the tree keeps weekend rules in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, the small extraction it needs and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable and small, with a named shift constant; a maintainer still has three places that encode the daily weekend-skip rule.
